high_level_description: The image appears to be a slide from a presentation, likely given at MIT (as indicated by the logo in the bottom right corner). The slide is titled "Why Should we Study the Human Brain in the first place?" and lists three bullet points explaining the reasons for studying the human brain: To know thyself. Your mind/brain is who you are; understand yourself! To understand the origins and limitations of human knowledge (empirical epistemology). (how) does the structure of our brain shape the structure of our thought? To advance AI.
